heroTitle: Dull Skin: Why The Glow Goes, And How To Get It Back
shortDesc: Tired, uneven, lacklustre skin has real causes. What they are, and the treatments that restore radiance for longer than a facial.
intro: Dull skin looks tired, uneven and lacklustre even when you are well rested. Healthy skin reflects light evenly; dull skin scatters it, because of a build-up of dead cells on the surface, a layer of tan and pigmentation beneath, and dehydration that leaves the texture rough. In Pune, sun, pollution and long commutes are the usual culprits, and all of them are treatable.

A salon facial adds a day of shine by cleaning and moisturising the surface. Dermatologist-led treatment at Skin Essence in Kalyani Nagar works on the causes: restoring the skin barrier, removing the damaged surface layer and treating the tan underneath. Dr. Daksha Patel examines your skin first and chooses the combination that suits it, which is also how we plan pre-wedding and pre-event skin.
causes: Build-up of dead skin cells from slow cell turnover
Sun tan and uneven pigmentation from daily UV exposure
Dehydration and a damaged skin barrier from harsh cleansers and over-exfoliation
Pollution, dust and smoke during commuting
Lack of sleep, smoking and nutritional deficiencies
Early ageing and loss of collagen

howWeTreat.title: Skin analysis
howWeTreat.description: Tone, texture, hydration and congestion are assessed under magnification, and the products you use are reviewed.

howWeTreat.title: Resurface and hydrate
howWeTreat.description: The Signature Mira Peel or a HydraFacial lifts dead cells and congestion and infuses hydrating serums, with no downtime.

howWeTreat.title: Correct tone
howWeTreat.description: VVS or Troi from our Korean peel range, a chemical peel, or laser toning treats the tan and pigmentation that make skin look flat.

howWeTreat.title: Keep it
howWeTreat.description: A simple home routine with sunscreen and the right actives holds the result, with a maintenance session every month or two.

selfCare: Sunscreen every morning is the single most effective glow product.
Use a gentle cleanser and a moisturiser suited to your skin; avoid daily scrubbing.
Drink enough water and sleep at regular hours.
Introduce vitamin C or a retinoid slowly, on a dermatologist's advice.
whenToSeeDoctor: Your skin looks dull despite a consistent routine.
Tan and uneven tone are not fading.
You have an event in 4 to 8 weeks and want a plan rather than a last-minute facial.
Dullness came on with tiredness, hair fall or weight change, which may need tests.

faqs.q: How quickly can I get a glow before an event?
faqs.a: A Signature Mira Peel or VVS Peel a few days before an event gives a visible glow if you have had it before. For lasting improvement a course over 2 to 3 months is better, which is why bridal preparation starts early.

faqs.q: Are salon facials bad for the skin?
faqs.a: Occasional gentle facials are fine for most people, but steam, scrubs and bleach often irritate sensitive or acne-prone skin. Treatments chosen by a dermatologist work on the cause of dullness rather than the surface alone.

faqs.q: Which glow treatment is right for me?
faqs.a: Tan and dead-skin build-up respond to the Mira Peel and Korean peels, congestion to HydraFacial, and dehydration with fine lines to skin boosters. The plan is set after examining your skin.

faqs.q: How long do the results last?
faqs.a: A single session lasts two to four weeks. With sunscreen and a good routine, a course of sessions followed by monthly maintenance keeps the skin consistently brighter.
